column1: # O1 D10: network, repair and sharing rows

column3: Wi-Fi: QR code of the current network
column9: Shows the password and a QR code of the connected network (scan it with a phone). The password is visible on screen: do not do this while sharing the screen.
Latency, download (50 MB) and upload (20 MB) against speed.cloudflare.com; no account, nothing is stored. Uses real traffic.
Asks first. A running call or recording drops while the audio stack restarts; audio-ensure runs afterwards.
Asks first. The connection drops for a few seconds.
Asks first. The touchpad is disabled for a second and enabled again (device config in Hyprland).
Asks first. The notification history is lost.

column3: Transcode a picture or video for sharing
column9: Pick a file from the screenshot, recording and download folders, a format and a size (3160/2160/1080 px pictures, 1080p/720p/4k videos, GIF). The result is saved next to the original and its file:// URI is copied for drag and drop.

column3: Download the video from the clipboard URL (yt-dlp)
column9: Copy a video URL first (Zen, Telegram, anywhere). The file lands in ~/Videos/downloads.

column3: Media: player menu (next, previous, focus the player)
column9: The same menu as a right click on the waybar media module.
